continuities.name: Alien (films and Alien: Earth)
continuities.description: The Alien film series (including the Prometheus prequels and Alien: Romulus) and the Alien: Earth TV series, ordered by the Alien franchise article's story chronology table.

continuities.name: Predator films
continuities.description: The Predator films from Predator (1987) to Predator: Badlands (2025). Kept separate from the Alien continuity: the films reference each other (Weyland-Yutani appears in Badlands) but Wikipedia gives no shared chronology, and Badlands' placement after the Alien films is a director statement.
continuities.quote: In October 2025, Trachtenberg stated in an interview with IGN that Predator: Badlands is set in the far future after the events of all the previous Alien and Alien vs. Predator films and the Alien: Earth TV-series so as to avoid any potential continuity conflicts, considering Romulus and Earth were still in production when Badlands was being produced.

continuities.name: Alien vs. Predator films
continuities.description: The two crossover films. Their canon relative to the Alien series is contested: they were intended as a Predator sequel and Alien prequel, but the Alien franchise's story chronology omits them, and unused endings of The Predator (2018) tied the franchises together "in a manner separate from the pre-existing Alien vs. Predator" films. Kept as their own continuity, linked to both.
continuities.quote: Alien vs. Predator was intended to be a sequel to the Predator films and prequel to the Alien series, Anderson was cautious of contradicting continuity in the franchises.
